correctness.rationale: The exactly-one neighborhoods yield the three-cycle 00→01→10→00 of 1-edges. Immediately before an isolated zero only 00 and 10 can both follow a 1 and start a 0-edge that permits the next 1. Following that 0-edge and the next a steps of the three-cycle gives the stated two-state partial permutations. Closed walks represent same-length indexed inputs, including n=1,2 with repeated neighbors. A projector forces at most one fixed start; a pure product of swaps fixes both states precisely at even gap count. All-ones has the three cyclic starts exactly when 3 divides n. The determinant of I-U has factors (1+z)(1-z-z^3)/(1-z^3); counting marked zeros gives n/m, even for words with smaller least period. At n=3k the duplicate contribution is Σ_{m≥2 even}(3k/m)binom(k-1,m-1)=3(2^(k-1)-1), confirming the subtraction and rational OGF independently of its log expression. The recurrence t_n is the sum of nth powers of the three roots of x^3-x^2-1 by Vieta; the conjugate pair has modulus λ^(-1/2), so the error bound and unit leading coefficient follow. All cyclic 00-avoiding words have count φ^n+(-φ^(-1))^n by the two-state adjacency trace, which gives the stated rate. No proof for unrestricted outputs is inferred.
correctness.replay: python3 /workspace/branches/frozen_replay.py 5 independently enumerates exact Rule-22 updates using cyclically rotated masks, via XOR of the three inputs with the triple-one case removed. For n=1..18 the counts, doubled counts and all-ones fibers match; at n=18 there are 879 reachable targets, 93 doubled fibers and one triple fiber. The frozen Python was inspected without execution.

value.rationale: The shortest forbidden-word constraint on zeros is natural and isolates a structured high-density target class in a canonical rule. An exact same-ring existence test becomes a complete fiber size law; it distinguishes when counting paths overcounts targets, and the exact image census quantifies the loss of reachable configurations at every length. The value lies in this joint characterization and the distinct count, not in recomputing a spectral radius.
